tanim: Residents in Eslant are fighting with fear every night. What is happening in Eslant¡¦?
ilerleme: Get rid of the cause of the nightmare hidden in the northeast forest of Eslant, and regain peace!
teklif: Given the shape of the monster, I suspect it's a Buro, a monster living in the northeastern part of the forest. They're said to be capable of real magic, but who knows? If they're the real cause of the nightmares, they should be removed...
